CASE FILE: WEB-03
UNIT: Application Security Response
STATUS: OPEN

A legacy communications portal was recovered from an exposed web archive after its maintainers reported that an old deployment package had been published unintentionally.

The visible website appears harmless. The original developers used separate files for page structure, presentation and browser-side interactions.

Investigators suspect that a deployment marker was left in the client-side source files during a previous build.

OBJECTIVE
Inspect the recovered portal and reconstruct the three-part deployment marker.

HANDOUTS
Exhibit A — Recovered portal snapshot
Exhibit B — Evidence intake note

The portal is supplied locally in this package. No external service, account or login is required.
